features.title: Initialise harness docs (AGENTS.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/*)
features.user_visible_behavior: Repo contains a top-level entry file, architecture map, feature list, progress log, init script, clean-state checklist, evaluator rubric, and quality document. A fresh agent can answer the five-question fresh-session test from disk.
features.verification: cd activity-tracker-app && yarn lint && cd ../activity-server && node -e "require('./app.js')" 2>&1 | head -5; ls AGENTS.md ARCHITECTURE.md README.md SECURITY.md docs/feature_list.json docs/PROGRESS.md docs/init.sh docs/clean-state-checklist.md docs/evaluator-rubric.md docs/quality-document.md
features.evidence: Files created; init.sh is idempotent; eslint config unchanged
features.notes: Docs only — no code change. Closes the 'knowledge visibility gap' identified in Lecture 03.

features.title: Rotate leaked secrets and remove .env from git history
features.user_visible_behavior: DBURL, ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET, REFRESH_TOKEN_SECRET are not present in the repository. A new .env.example documents required keys.
features.verification: git -C activity-tracker log --all --oneline -- activity-server/.env | head; test ! -f activity-server/.env || grep -q '^DBURL=' activity-server/.env; (cd activity-server && cp .env .env.example && sed -i 's|=.*$|=<set-me>|' .env.example)
features.notes: See SECURITY.md. Requires user approval before any rewrite of history.

features.title: Fix access-token lifetime in update_user (30d -> 180m)
features.user_visible_behavior: Calling POST /updateUser returns an access token that expires in 180 minutes, matching login_user.
features.notes: Trivial one-line fix; verification just needs to show the second token uses 180m.

features.title: Replace hard-coded serverURL with VITE_API_URL
features.user_visible_behavior: Setting VITE_API_URL at build time changes the API base URL used by all Redux actions. No code change is required to switch environments.
features.verification: grep -n 'VITE_API_URL' activity-tracker-app/src/Redux/actions.jsx; VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:8000 yarn build && ! grep -q 'myactivitytracker.herokuapp.com' activity-tracker-app/dist/assets/*.js 2>/dev/null || true

features.title: Wire Save / Cancel in AccountSettings
features.user_visible_behavior: Editing firstName, lastName, or email and pressing Save updates the user on the server and in Redux. Cancel reverts the form.
features.notes: The two buttons currently call () => null.

features.title: Rename Category.account -> Category.accountId
features.user_visible_behavior: The Category model uses the same field name as the other models. No behavioural change.
features.notes: This is a refactor — requires a migration that copies the field and unsets the old one. Add the migration to scripts/ before flipping the model.

features.title: Mount or remove socket.io
features.user_visible_behavior: Either a Socket.IO server is exposed at /realtime and used by the client, or the dependency is removed from package.json and the require() in app.js.
features.verification: grep -n 'socket' activity-server/app.js activity-server/package.json; node -e "const io = require('socket.io')(3000); setTimeout(() => process.exit(0), 100)"
features.notes: Currently imported on line 4 of app.js and never used.

features.title: Drop legacy Goal.history field after migration
features.user_visible_behavior: The Goal schema no longer declares a history array. The migration script has been run on production data.
features.notes: Schema currently keeps the legacy field for backward compatibility. Add a feature entry for the schema change and another for running the migration in prod.

features.title: Restrict CORS to known origins
features.user_visible_behavior: Cross-origin requests from unlisted origins are rejected by the browser.
features.verification: grep -n 'cors' activity-server/app.js; node -e "const cors=require('cors'); console.log(typeof cors({origin: ['http://localhost:5173']}))"

features.title: Add error/empty paths to Login & SignUp
features.user_visible_behavior: When the API returns an error or the network fails, the user sees a non-blocking error message instead of a hung button.
features.notes: The .then chain on the dispatch has no .catch.

features.title: Structured request logger middleware
features.user_visible_behavior: Every request logs a single JSON line containing method, path, status, latency, and the authenticated user id (when present).
features.notes: Today the only output is console.log/error inside controllers.
